{{Top|leg}}
'''Spraymist''' was a solution that was manufactured exclusively by the [[Stokhli/Legends|Stokhli]] for use in their [[Spray stick/Legends|spray sticks]]. A thin translucent mist, spraymist transformed into a liquid once exposed to cool air, and then rapidly turned into a solid [[Spraynet/Legends|spraynet]]. Spraymist was resistant to most known solvents, [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]], and even [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], and could transmit a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] charge to an ensnared target. Spraymist naturally decayed after several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> A spraymist stream could also be melted by extremely high temperatures; [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] were capable of raising the external temperature of their chassis to melt incoming spraymist streams.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
